name: Nexus Agentic Studio
tag: Audits your manual processes, calculates the return on automating them and deploys secure automated workflows.

scenarios.title: Audit order entry
scenarios.ask: Our team re-keys {orders} emailed orders a week into the ERP. Audit it and automate what makes sense.
steps: Watched the steps: open email, read PDF, look up customer, enter lines, confirm. About {minutes} per order.
Found about 2% of orders had a wrong quantity or item code.
Designed a workflow: read the order, match items, enter a draft, a person approves.
Gave it access only to the order inbox and the ERP order screen, with every action logged.
followups: What if an order is unusual?
Anything it can't match with confidence goes to a person with the mismatch highlighted.
It runs with the least access needed, credentials are stored in a vault and every action is logged.

scenarios.title: Rank processes by ROI
scenarios.ask: We listed {processes} manual processes. Which should we automate first?
steps: Collected time, volume and error data for {processes} processes.
Estimated value and build cost for each.
Top {=max(1, round(processes / 4))} fit within your budget and pay back fastest.
Laid out a build order with milestones.
followups: Where do the time numbers come from?
From short interviews and, where possible, system logs. You can correct any number before ranking.
What if we have more budget later?
The ranking stays, and the next items in line move into the plan.

scenarios.title: Deploy and monitor a workflow
scenarios.ask: Deploy the approved invoice-matching workflow for {invoices} invoices a month and watch it.
steps: Tracks match rate, exceptions and time per invoice.
Checks access logs daily for anything unusual.
followups: The workflow runs alongside your team without changing anything, so you can compare its decisions with theirs first.
When should we turn on auto?
Many teams switch once shadow results agree with staff on almost all exact matches for a few weeks.
